verdict.rationale: Region selection is a fair question for a cloud platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a published Azure region list or a per-region service-availability page or tool. A community mention of an outage in a named region shows that regions exist. It is not evidence of a published list or of an availability-checking capability.

support.subject: As an operations lead, I can pick where things run — a published region list with per-region service availability I can check before committing
